title: Szczecin Cathedral
scope: The standing Cathedral Basilica of St James in Szczecin, including its brick hall church, polygonal apsidal choir, attached side chambers, and the restored 110.18 m west spire.
limitations: The present church and restored west spire are modeled. Separate nearby houses and stained-glass interiors are outside the scope.
The original and restored tower features, broad green roof and wall alignments are grounded in the photos and mapped building. Fine masonry patterns and chapel roofs are representative.
The open elevation field resolves the general street slope only; exact curb heights are below its source resolution.
